title: Finding Only Eyes

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Canyon Crescent, southerly 2 to gale wind 5. Falling slowly. So slowly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Canyon Crescent, southerly 2 to gale wind 5. Falling slowly. So slowly.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: This is Ivan Iker McGuire with the shipping forecast from CurzoLive. For tidings you can trust... You are a very fine hallucination. Auditory AND visual.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is Ivan Iker McGuire with the shipping forecast from CurzoLive. For tidings you can trust... You are a very fine hallucination. Auditory AND visual.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: My dermis and connective tissue were eaten away by the coastal wind. Luckily, my eyes are glass. They're all I need. Only eyes! Ha!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My dermis and connective tissue were eaten away by the coastal wind. Luckily, my eyes are glass. They're all I need. Only eyes! Ha!

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Leave my post? But then who would read the forecast? Shipping would grind to a halt! It would - ChronoTown, north-easterly rising 3 or 4 - be chaos!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Leave my post? But then who would read the forecast? Shipping would grind to a halt! It would - ChronoTown, north-easterly rising 3 or 4 - be chaos!

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: And I won't let them down. This is Ivan McGuire, and you're listening to the shipping forecast. Sponsored by CurzoLive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And I won't let them down. This is Ivan McGuire, and you're listening to the shipping forecast. Sponsored by CurzoLive.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: ... I don't understand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: So, I... Indigo Shoals, southwest by... I... I've just been talking to myself? For years?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, I... Indigo Shoals, southwest by... I... I've just been talking to myself? For years?

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Then what's the point of me? Of - Sunshine beach, north by northwest, rising 3 or 4 - of continuing this miserable existence?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then what's the point of me? Of - Sunshine beach, north by northwest, rising 3 or 4 - of continuing this miserable existence?

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: That's true. Did my broadcast save you from peril on the waves?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's true. Did my broadcast save you from peril on the waves?

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Then all the years of loneliness, of feeling my skin eaten away by the winds and rain and birds... it has all been worth it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then all the years of loneliness, of feeling my skin eaten away by the winds and rain and birds... it has all been worth it.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Then what's the point of me? Of - Sunshine beach, north by northwest, rising 3 or 4 - of continuing this miserable existence?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then what's the point of me? Of - Sunshine beach, north by northwest, rising 3 or 4 - of continuing this miserable existence?

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Remain here at my post, of course. If I saved you, perhaps I will save another traveller with the shipping forecast, brought to you by me, Ivan Iker McGuire.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Remain here at my post, of course. If I saved you, perhaps I will save another traveller with the shipping forecast, brought to you by me, Ivan Iker McGuire.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: But all I know is the forecast. Paradise Point, east by southeast, falling, falling...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But all I know is the forecast. Paradise Point, east by southeast, falling, falling...

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Eryka Rocks, south by southeast, squally showers, 4 or 5. Rising and rising!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eryka Rocks, south by southeast, squally showers, 4 or 5. Rising and rising!

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: A real studio? One that still exists? I have never told anyone this, but... I always dreamed of having my own talk show. One where listeners speak back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A real studio? One that still exists? I have never told anyone this, but... I always dreamed of having my own talk show. One where listeners speak back.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: A real radio announcer? I have never told anyone this, but... I always dreamed of having my own talk show. One where listeners speak back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A real radio announcer? I have never told anyone this, but... I always dreamed of having my own talk show. One where listeners speak back.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: I don't know how to thank you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know how to thank you.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Well, then this is Ivan Iker McGuire, signing off.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, then this is Ivan Iker McGuire, signing off.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: You're honest. I appreciate that. Now please, leave me. I have... a lot of thinking to do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're honest. I appreciate that. Now please, leave me. I have... a lot of thinking to do.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: I apologize. It has been a long time since I have seen a meat-person.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I apologize. It has been a long time since I have seen a meat-person.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: I have been reading the shipping forecast - sponsored by Curzona - for as long as I can remember. Decades. Centuries.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have been reading the shipping forecast - sponsored by Curzona - for as long as I can remember. Decades. Centuries.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Um, hi.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Um, hi.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened to your skin?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened to your skin?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why don't you just get new dermis?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why don't you just get new dermis?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why don't you just get new dermis?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why don't you just get new dermis?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fair point. The people need you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fair point. The people need you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fair point. The people need you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fair point. The people need you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I hate to tell you, but I don't think anyone is listening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hate to tell you, but I don't think anyone is listening.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I hate to tell you, but I don't think anyone is listening.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I hate to tell you, but I don't think anyone is listening.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: People don't need the forecast. They have Automatas.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People don't need the forecast. They have Automatas.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: People don't need the forecast. They have Automatas.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: People don't need the forecast. They have Automatas.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: 'Fraid so.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 'Fraid so.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hey, I heard you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, I heard you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, totally.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, yeah, totally.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ... not really.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... not really.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What will you do now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What will you do now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You could do something else.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You could do something else.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I know a studio in need of an announcer...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know a studio in need of an announcer...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I know a studio in need of an announcer...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I know a studio in need of an announcer...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I know a radio announcer who might take you on as an apprentice...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know a radio announcer who might take you on as an apprentice...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I know a radio announcer who might take you on as an apprentice...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I know a radio announcer who might take you on as an apprentice...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I didn't mean...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't mean...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Never mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Go for it! I'll ask Ava to send you the details.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go for it! I'll ask Ava to send you the details.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Go for it! I'll ask Ava to send you the details.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Go for it! I'll ask Ava to send you the details.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Don't mention it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't mention it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Dunno, really.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Dunno, really.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm really not a hallucination.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm really not a hallucination.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How long?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How long?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you've never left?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you've never left?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I know a studio in need of an announcer...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know a studio in need of an announcer...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I know a studio in need of an announcer...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I know a studio in need of an announcer...
